MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 44
   D. 22

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

5. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

11. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 12
   C. 16
   D. 5

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

13. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 19

18. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 11

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

22. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 11

23. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

24. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
